title: Claude-assisted discovery of a dangling channel pointer in OpenEXRCore
organization: Academy Software Foundation / Ada Logics / Anthropic
summary: An error path in exr_copy_unset_attributes can leave a dangling part->channels pointer after freeing channel data. Under the documented ordering condition, later error handling can obscure the original failure. The advisory limits applicability to applications using the OpenEXRCore API; it does not establish a downstream code-execution effect.
ai_role: The OpenEXR advisory says the issue was found using Claude and validated by an Ada Logics researcher. The source does not specify a model or establish autonomous discovery.
classification_note: The cited vendor advisory records disclosure and AI attribution; it does not report exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: The advisory lists fixed OpenEXR release lines 3.3.15, 3.4.17 and 3.5.3. It does not establish downstream package status.

impacts.conditions: The issue is in exr_copy_unset_attributes and applies to applications using the OpenEXRCore API; the advisory describes a dangling pointer on an error path. No further security consequence is asserted here.
impacts.exploitation: The advisory does not report exploitation in the wild.
